title: Why Your Best Ideas Hit You in the Shower
caption:
Why do your best ideas strike in the shower?
A soggy stick figure zones out under hot water, a lightbulb flashes Eureka, and his brain soaks in its own tub of ideas.
Relaxing tasks switch on the default mode network, the brain's subconscious creative link that wires distant ideas together.
What brilliant thought have you lost because you couldn't write it down?
Save this before it washes away, and share it with a fellow overthinker!
